verdict.rationale: Box AI is a built-in assistant embedded in the product for asking questions, extracting metadata, summarizing, generating, and querying content with permissions intact (box-docs-9, box-docs-12, box-docs-13, box-docs-26, box-docs-30), directly matching the story of delegating tasks to an in-product AI assistant. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating Box AI's assistant behavior and more detail on task delegation beyond summarize/extract/query use cases.
